description: Finds files and folders by name (like find -name) under a folder inside the allowed folders, e.g. core_dump. Lists their paths; folders end with /. Use grep to search file contents instead.

params.name: path
params.description: Folder to search under, starting with an allowed folder name, e.g. core_dump

params.name: name
params.description: Glob for the name, e.g. *.c, Makefile or *test*; omit it to list everything

params.name: type
params.description: f for files only, d for folders only; omit it for both

params.name: max_depth
params.description: How many folder levels to descend, 1 to 20; omit it for all

params.name: ignore_case
params.description: Match the name regardless of case
